title: Jazz Is Dead
style: Off-kilter jazz built around a drip-click-hum motif that starts staggered, then locks into a steady swing pocket. Foreground walking upright bass or lyrical fretless bass carries the melody, with warm Rhodes comping, sparse piano voicings, brushed snare, and laid-back ride cymbal. Close-mic breathy vocals, tape saturation, soft room reverb, and subtle horn counterlines.
lyrics:
[Verse]
And it don't stop, and it don't quit
The revolution is dead, and this is it
It's the free people party and we politic
We don't play the background, we the lead in the skit
Yeah, we play the cut, then we jump in the mix
The revolutionary sound, we insist
The preacher man sound like he from the pulpit
"Jazz is dead, jazz is dead," but this is it

[Pre-Chorus]
A whole lotta soul, and it sounds so legit
A pocket full of soul, that's what it is
A pocket full of soul, that's what it is
A pocket full of soul, that's what it is
A pocket full of soul, that's what it is

[Chorus]
It sounds like a groove, but it's more like a movement
Jazz is dead, jazz is dead, but it's still movin'
It sounds like a groove, but it's more like a movement
Jazz is dead, jazz is dead, but it's still movin'

[Verse 2]
It feels like a movement and it sounds like a groove
Like it ain't got nothin' to prove
And if you ain't feelin' it, then somethin' wrong with you
'Cause you just can't make a soul move
You just can't make a soul move
